primary_messages.content_text:
july 17 Notes:


I was just watching charts this day and I saw some opportunities, but since I was working I wasn’t trading.
,
One thing that is interesting about today is I was thinking of the ict concept tgif (Thank god it’s friday) which happens when we see a large move down through monday through thursday we can see a retracement into the 20%-30% of the weekly range on friday. With that being said I was looking to have a bullish bias today. Price dropped over night hundreds of points during the overnight session and we saw a last judas at market open down into a bullish daily rb where we saw a big move up before and through 10:00 opening.
,
The first entry I would have like to see was a short after 10:00. We traded higher and swept equal highs and tapped a 4h bearish fvg and after tapping it we got some consolidation, but we made 1 move higher and made a 15min rb rejecting the 4h gap. Since it is a 15m wick, I would scaled down to the 1min and enter off of a 1min fvg inside the wick for better risk. Target is 10:00 and that would have been a successful trade. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
The next entry would have been a perfect bottom tick entry off of 10:00. 10:00 was in the discount of the range, and there was only 10pts of manipulation under 10:00 and usually I would like more, but we tapped into an hourly rb making it a valid 10:00 setup in my eyes. (Screenshot 3)
,

june 16 Notes:


This day was a vey unfortunate trading day as I ended with a loss, and a brutal, brutal breakeven.
,
9:30 opened and traded lower sweeping out daily lows and trading into a daily bullish rb and we rallied after this going into 10:00 putting it in a range. 10:00 opened and traded lower, tapping a 15min rb that rejected the sweep of el and tap of the rb, so I knew if we traded back into 10:00 it would be a great trade. My first trade was not this though, we traded lower into the range and tapped discount and a 5min fvg and created a 5min rb which is my model. The only problem here is that we didn’t tap 10:00. I entered anyways knowing that this could play out, or this is generating el for 10:00 which will be my re entry. it did get stopped, but then I entered 10: which did give a perfect entry. Now, I should have exited at the first swing high which was 110 points, a sufficient trade and a 1:5rr, but I was too ambitious and thought we would take out all the el above and I got stopped for this brutal breakeven. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
that first tp was definitely sufficient and those are the size trades I should be aiming for on this funded anyways and I could have broken this losing streak and I guess if I have to take away something positive it is that this adds more conviction to my edge and proves that I am very capable.
,

My first trade was not this though, we traded lower into the range and tapped discount and a 5min fvg and created a 5min rb which is my model. The only problem here is that we didn’t tap 10:00. I entered anyways knowing that this could play out, or this is generating el for 10:00 which will be my re entry. it did get stopped, but then I entered 10: which did give a perfect entry. Now, I should have exited at the first swing high which was 110 points, a sufficient trade and a 1:5rr, but I was too ambitious and thought we would take out all the el above and I got stopped for this brutal breakeven. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
that first tp was definitely sufficient and those are the size trades I should be aiming for on this funded anyways and I could have broken this losing streak and I guess if I have to take away something positive it is that this adds more conviction to my edge and proves that I am very capable.
,

july 15 Notes:


Lost 2 trades unfortunately this day. This journal comes a little late, but here it is. Next week I will do a good job of completing every journal I have in a timely manner.
,
Going into market open, it looked like we had a clear draw which was relative equal highs and a high tf market maker buy model. We had swept those daily equal lows, reacted out, traded back down into ote and back up making this mmxm. This meant I was bullish for the day. Market traded down aggressively at market open into the ote of this new range and I saw a stack of relative equal lows and accumulation that got swept near the 0.705 and once we swept it, we got a bullish 5min rb. The problem is that the wick was too big and I entered off of it with a meaningless stop loss and got stopped. We then accumulated in this area and we got a resweep of the low and a new bullish 5min rb and I entered again, but had the same problem: meaningless stop just in the middle of the wick somewhere and got stopped. Now, neither of these trades would have properly hit my tp, but they would have been enough to get be or a trailed win. (Screenshots 1-3)
,
I mentioned that neither of these trades hit my tp, and one thing that I think could have been an issue is that it doesn’t really make sense for us to sweep level, rally, trade into ote, make mmxm make relative equal highs with the top of it, and then trade back to ote again and expect another rally. How I should have interpreted it was htf liquidity generation, and just sat on my hand not knowing a proper direction. Another thing is That I should adjust my entry in order to cover the wick with sl, not adjust my sl to get into the trade. lessons learned.
,

My bias was bearish today because we put in some lows right below previous month lows. Then, we left 10AM open with no bottom wick. Then, we swept equal highs below a 1HR FVG. So, naturally my bias was bearish down to those lows.

I was emotionless before and during the trade, but because I'm risking a lot more on trades now, my mentality was kinda cooked after I took that loss. primary_messages.author: Ferrone
primary_messages.content_text:
Day 3
7/16/26

Coming into today we are selling off very clearly, we've swept PDL and HTF ext liq while ES hasnt setting a bullish SMT. On the 1h we are trading into a 1h bearish FVG taking internal on the ltf setting now a bearish SMT. Ideal scenario for open is we manipulate into the 1h for ES taking internal buyside for a continuation lower into london lows. For us to trade higher, I want a sweep of london lows or we retrace into OTE then have a clear market structure shift to the upside.

Off open we do get that manipulation higher then a strong rejection into our OTE range +15m FVG. Ideally is we inverse this gap. I am looking for a pop back into this 1m + premium to target our london lows. This trade is a 2.78R down to our london lows. This was taken on paper but a good clean delivery.

We are now sweeping out external sellside. At this point we have a fairly large SMT. For us to take a continuation lower, a slower move up creating LRL or a strong recovery for a reversal. Emotional I feel fine. Since this is on paper I don't feel anything much rather I'm happy that first trade was clean. 

Took an attempt at a reversal, swept external+iFVG+BoS+OTE retracement. Looked good but it seems we've been wicked out, this looks for a classic resweep with now an internal SMT which honestly makes this setup higher quality but I never got the reentry

primary_messages.author: Frank
primary_messages.content_text:
I’m 21, living at home, and I’m ready to stop dreaming and start building. My ultimate goal is simple: I want out of the 9-to-5 rat race so I can live life on my own terms.

To be completely honest, this isn't my first attempt at building something of my own. I previously tried dropshipping, but it ended up being a tough lesson. It was incredibly cash-flow intensive, and I ended up losing a lot of money in the process. That experience taught me a lot about business, but it also made me realize I need a path that’s more sustainable and doesn't require massive upfront capital to get started.

That’s why I’m turning to trading. The ability to work with funded accounts gives me a realistic way to start without risking everything I have.

I’m sharing this journal here because I need a reality check. I know I’m still a beginner, and I want to be held accountable. If you see me getting emotional, deviating from my plan, or making the same stupid mistakes over and over again, please call me out.

primary_messages.author: Liam
primary_messages.content_text:
july 14 Notes:


I took a small loss today, but I am actually quite happy with it, because I think it was a really good trade.
,
Today was cpi, which gave very bullish numbers and made a bullish move on indexes. At 9:30 open we consolidated a little in the middle of the data candle and at 10:00 we saw an aggressive move sweeping data lows and making an smt with it. We then traded higher and made relative equal highs with the data highs, and in the process, 10:00 aligned perfectly with the 0.5 of the range. It also aligned with a 15min gap fill and 5min bearish candle closures (2 of them, kind of an order block of sorts) making this a good setup for me. I placed a limit at 10:00, and when we tapped it we got a one min rb and I trailed my stoploss and got stopped soon after. The reason I trailed is because I said to myself that I don’t want to participate in the move below this rb. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
Not mad at this loss at all.  This is one I can take with pride as I identified my model and executed with confidence. That is what I need to do to be profitable, so I continue on like this.
,

I did not trade this day because of work, but I did not really see a move I’d like to participate in regardless.
,

primary_messages.author: Ferrone
primary_messages.content_text:
Day 2
7/14/26

Starting off day 2 strong, im feeling good and motivated. Calm. Ready to let the market come to me today. Ready to not force anything.

CPI day today. Today's looking as though we could go either way. We retraced to OTE on the 4h overnight but we are now rejecting out of a large 4h + 1h RB + OTE from the leg down yesterday. We've also swept out buyside, however we are pushing higher strong overnight so I don't want to discount the current trend. We have CPI low below us that will probably want to be taken out which lies right above a 15m FVG. This could be a good place to long out of if we have a nice setup but we also have london lows + some other 1h FVGs.

As we open we sell off first 5m breaking structure into OTE yet we are retracing now leaving data lows intact. This could be a potential draw to trade towards since we attacked it without grabbing it. We are trading higher into the macro now, I'm not particularily fond of longs without sweeping data lows or some more prominent liquidity.

Coming into the macro we are accumulating. We had an AMD at premarket then open except we never distributed, we started accumulating again. At this point, it's really just sit on hands and wait for something to align with my model and risk. 

First trade, we finally got a move lower into into .705 ote + data lows + 15m FVG + bullish SMT, I take the trade long. As we get a move higher I remove some risk. Eventually I get stopped out. I'd give this trade probably a B since we had all these higher timeframe confluences to push higher but I didn't want to wait for 1m confirmation of a bos or displacement. I give it one more re entry after we resweep the low but i get out breakeven. 

At this point I only have enough drawdown for 1 more trade. We push lower,

primary_messages.content_text:
DAY 30  : 2 TRADES 1 BE 1L

Technical Analysis
Was bullish on friday, we dumped sunday open which gives me a bias of OLHC. from how low price dumped and also took out liquidity on both pre and am session, i wanted longs. waited patiently for a reversal and on top of that, a confirmation that we were flipping bullish. it was good that i did because price dumped crazy fast and took out a lot of liquidity. waited for the breaker of that manipulation to get tapped, and didn't enter until a good reaction was seen. so i honestly entered late, but stop was already too wide. the second retest would have been the right move. entered in before the macro so price delivered quite well once macro started but hit a wall and started to dump, breaking me even.

Second trade was a rule break, i entered in after my designated allotted time. Also was trying to find the reversal, this time i did not wait for confirmation, i used stdv and waited for a breaker in that position. price did not respect it and i got stopped out.

Psychological analysis
Was very patient in the beginning which was great, still got a bit nervous mid trade, but then calmed down as i realize that i'm BE. There's nothing to lose. though there is the FOMO of losing profits but there will be days where it will hit TP so i wouldn't worry so much. Second trade i knew it was out of my time window and PA didn't look pretty, but i still took it. Always by second trade i'm starting to justify rule breaks.

primary_messages.content_text:
Day 1
7/13/26

0/1; -1R -700

Feeling good and refreshed. Ready to take this week on. Ready to take things slow.

PreMarket: On the daily we've traded lower into this daily BPR, could be a could place to hold if we want higher levels. PDH, relative equal highs above 400pts away. 4h bearish imbalance as well right above. On the 1h, we've sold off big during asia, recovered some of it during London. Will we hold this daily and continue rebalance or start the next leg down? We've already retraced 50% of this leg down. The 15m looks nuetral I need to wait to see once we open if we're wanting this to be a leg lower or hold to go higher.

Off open Nasdaq sells lower taking lows while ES does that opposite. Both setting their own SMTs. I want to lean bearish because we have a lot of LRL, but NQ could take these levels before I get an opportunity. 

As we enter the macro we are still sweeping lows on NQ while ES is holding this 5m. We sweep london lows on NQ setting more bullish SMTs, we get a 30s inverse where I take it long stops at the lows. Targetting 1:3. We chop around for a bit then get stopped out at the lows. 

This trade was not ideal because: I did not wait for the 30s to close before entering. When we did get the close it wasn't a strong displacement close. I don't normally trade 30 seconds anyway. There was just no overall clean confirmation that I had waited for. The trade idea was relatively right it seems, we are trading higher now. But we had to go lower then get that BoS + displacement higher. I'd probably give this a C personally. Definitely wasn't the cleanest trade. I am finished for the day though and will come back tmrw

We come back tomorrow.

primary_messages.content_text:
july 9 Notes:


This journal comes a few day late, but I took a loss on this day trying to trade 10:00. I think it came from a psychology issue that I will need to overcome.
,
Market rallied for the entire overnight session and we didn’t see a move down until 10:00 where there was an aggressive move down to 9:30 low and then a move up again. We left a 15min rb and we had a huge smt, and we had a 4h rb that we were rejecting out of. The problem is that we were way above the ote, and for that reason I thought the trade may not work, but I wanted to try the trade anyways. I think the reason is that I only have 2 days to trade because of work so the days that I can I will even take setups that maybe aren’t there just because I have to. Price also did give a reaction, but I hada bit too tight of a stoploss and lost instead of potentially going breakeven. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
I really can’t get emotional or else I am going to blow this funded. I am able to do it, so I just have to be smart.
,

primary_messages.content_text:
DAY 29  : 3 Trades 2 L 1 W

Technical Analysis
MMXM analysis was seeing AMD from accumlating asia/london and po3 into HRL lows and finding entry from there. BIAS was longs but plans changed as ES was very bullish and created an SMT, and during market open, took out HRL highs and hit -4 on stdv. this led me to believe that going for shorts may be more available today as opposed to longs. 

First trade
I saw NASDAQ was lagging and more bearish so i took an entry as ES hit its -4 stdv. But i didn't mark out NQ's stdv which would have told me that the -2 wasn't hit yet. this would have saved me from a losing trade. this was also impatience on my end. I needed to get confirmation first, and also see the liquidity sweeps. there was none on NQ until later. Gotta be more careful with decorrelated pairs. have extra confirmation and more confluences line up in your favor. for moments like these or don't trade. 1st trade was a gamble for sure. 

Second trade
ES hit -4 stdv, swept all HRL REH, tapped a 4HR RB, discount of entire 4hr range. I used 10am's po3 and decided to short AFTER a confirmation. Because we were in consolidation, i wanted to see the breakout and a strong retest of a breaker into delivery. i saw that, and waited for the second breaker and set a limit there. SL was covering both breaker ranges. and in a good PA scenario, it would have played out perfectly but because of news, it was consolidating more than it should have. and almost stopped me out before knifing straight down. Good trade. probably the best one i've done in a while. analysis, patience, and execution all there. 

Third trade
honestly a gamble trade. risk was like 70 dollars but i broke my rule either way. i don't want to do this again. in my eyes price hit -1 and was due for retest of breaker and a move back down. i saw the breaker tap, and wanted to get a continuation down from there, but it was actually a bullish setup forming. I should have known better since the lows got knife through, making it a MMBM. and because of news, it makes all the PA that much more choppy. 

Psychological Analysis
I was laser eyeing the 2nd trade as hard as possible. lowkey worked. delivery was not immediate and i became a bit nervous in drawdown. after the news candle, we were good. but biggest flaw is the impatience from the 1st trade and the rule break on the 3rd wanting to gamble for more. i fomo in a lot and that's what probably made me lose 98% of my trades in the past month. I gotta be okay with letting the trade run away from me. and not jumping in on every opportunity. quality over quantity here. as for the 3rd, i felt the devil on my shoulder telling my i could make more money if i took this trade. but it was against my rules and i still took it. doesn't matter the amount of risk, the fact that i put risk on a trade that shouldn't have been taken was bad enough. so let trades run away if they do and don't listen to the devil on my shoulder.

Day 42
7/10/26

Tired asf this morning kept waking up from nightmares wtf I got up in the middle of the night and check the locks on my apartment lmfao

Came into the morning feeling fine, thought price action looked pretty good as well to trade. What I saw was the daily iFVG below and some sellside that I wanted to see us manipulate into to go higher towards PDH. 

At open we run higher and take out some buyside where I short trying to catch a reversal, I see a 15m OB above that we could reverse off of so I allow for some drawdown. What I didn't realize was that I couldn't stomach that kind of drawdown so I started acting impulsively. Adding into my position where drawdown wouldn't allow then scaling out because it was too much red. We eventually push higher where the go closed out of the account 1 minute before we start rejecting. At that point I reset the eval because I knew that price was going to reject now and I catch the shorts for 75pts. 

Unfortunately it took me a try on a new eval and I didn't "preserve capital" for the position that followed right after.

primary_messages.author: saamson
primary_messages.content_text:
DAY 28  : 2 Trades 1 L 1 W

Technical Analysis
Started using the fractal model for better confirmation on trades, which has really helped filter all the shitty trades i could've taken. though, i missed the best trade from the 15 min rejection. I wanted better confirmation with the candle closure that we were going to flip bias and reverse. Chose ES because of the faster speed of where it was moving at. I've noticed that the faster index tends to go in premium and not touch discount over the other. But i do reference the weaker index to see if discount has been tapped, which it was.

First trade was off of a 1 min reaction off of a FVG which tapped discount of the current range. set my entry on the breaker EQ and stop at swing low, got stopped. 1 min swing wasn't very strong, the swing below it was actually higher resistance. Also didn't realize we were going into a 15 min OB which was probably why the trade failed. Also both indexes on the 15 min weren't strong in confirming a bull run. NQ was still closing bearish while ES was slowly starting to close bullish. But the candle i entered in was basically a doji candle at that point. wasn't strong enough conviction. The candle after was. especially the fact that it closed over the swing high of the 15 min.

Second trade was after the 15 min close above the swing high (CISD). I looked for a 1 min cisd along with a FVG retracement tap. Found the tap in discount and waited for the CISD. As that happened. i located the breaker and set my limit at the EQ of the range within the breaker. Since the PA was very bullish, i opted to EQ instead of discount because it can possibly leave it. The level was also layered with a 1 min FVG. Set my stdv on the breaker leg and went for -4. Starting partialing out around 3.5/3.8RR. Came out with a decent win.

Psychological Analysis

A lot more secure and confident in the analysis and trade selection stage, but still quite anxious during the in trade stage. Especially while in profit. I'm afraid of retracements and getting stopped out while in profit and losing what could be all the profit if i just closed the trade there. using the ticks help but i can't help to look at pnl while in trade for long amounts of time. This may be because i'm barely winning but i must assured that more wins will come as long as i stick to not pussying out and FOMO'ing. More winning trades are coming.

primary_messages.author: Ferrone
primary_messages.content_text:
Day 41
7/9/26

1/3 2 L's 1 W

Bit of a rollercoaster today, started the day off definitely with no certain bias. We open judas swing into a 15m, 1h, sweeping internal sellside followed by a clean reversal. I did not take this trade although I did see others take it all over socials. I waited for the macro to open at which point we got a clean displacement after filling the 4h and tapping 4h ob, BoS, IFVG. Shorts stops at the high in which we get stopped out quickly. Unfortunate I just think we wanted to push a bit higher and we traded out of a 5m bullish. 

When I got stopped out, and since we traded out of the 5m I switched my bias quickly. We had the displacement + CISD + IFVG and we had been bullish all morning so I take a continuation long. We chop in profit a little bit, I scale into at the open of a 5m FVG. To which I eventually close out early as we are rejecting a bearish 1h and we aren't getting clean delivery.

I take one final trade towards the downside which was my original idea and we get instant delivery, scale in a little more once in profit and we take profit at the lows to cover my losses and halfpass the new evaluation. 

Overall, the day was okay. I'd give it a B personally. My execution wasn't amazing and I needed to use a lot of discretion today. The market has been too weird this week for a mechanical approach, and it worked out today. My emotions were in set, although I did take multiple setups all relatively close together I wouldn't say they were revenge trades. Each idea was invalidated while showing the opposite side was most appealing. So all in all solid day, ready to come back tomorrow for a one and done setup lol.

primary_messages.content_text:
Max trades / day TWO trades allowed maximum.
1st trade = WIN Done for the day. Bank it, close the platform.
1st trade = BREAK-EVEN Second trade allowed. Risk stays the SAME (full starting risk).
1st trade = LOSS Second trade allowed, but sized at 50% of starting risk.
2nd trade (after any 1st) Whatever the result — done for the day. No third trade, no exceptions.
Minimum RR 1:3. Prefer 1:4–1:6.
Premium/discount Sell premium, buy discount. Shorting from discount / longing from
premium = flaw, not A+.
High-impact news Fed speakers, FOMC, CPI/PPI/NFP on your window → STAND DOWN,
not derisk.
Data days (8:30) Look at the chart at 8:30 for the data high/low. Otherwise wait for
10AM.
Monday / holiday High skip probability. Thin, choppy, unreliable — A+ only or skip.

primary_messages.author: Anton
primary_messages.content_text:
Stop loss
• Placement: above the manipulation high (shorts) / below the manipulation low (longs) — at the structure
that invalidates the setup, never a random number.
• Preferred size: under 20 points. 15 pts = acceptable. Around 25 pts = too big; either scale to micros and
extend the target, or drop to a clean 1m trigger inside the 5m for a tighter stop.
• Tiny stops (2–5 pts): great RR but more edge-out risk; going to BE may not even be worth it on a 2.5-pt
stop.
Take profit
• Target the clean draw from your bias — untouched PDH/PDL, session high/low, unfilled FVG / NWOG, or
1m/5m/15m gap fills.
• Countertrend 10AM trades: take the NEARER draw. Don't reach for the home run against the larger trend.
• Do not target past an uninverted HTF FVG expecting a clean run through it.
• Preferred RR band: 1:4 to 1:6 (“five to seven”). Minimum 1:3. Some setups extend to 1:7+ — fine if the
draw supports it.
Management — break-even & trailing
• Move to BE once, at the first clean 5m structural confirmation in your favor — then let it run to target.
• Do not micro-trail on 1m noise. It caps the winners a high-RR system depends on. If trailing beyond BE,
use 5m structure (below a 5m OB / 5m swing low).
• If trailing to 1m, only trail to SIGNIFICANT 1m reversal points (FVG, equal highs/lows) — never every minor
high.
• Track your BE-outs: if most would have hit target, your trail is too tight → loosen to 5m. Let your own
journal data decide.

primary_messages.author: Anton
primary_messages.content_text:
PD array at the level — 10AM lined up with FVG / OB / RB / OTE (the 2+ confluences).
,
Correct premium/discount — short from premium, long from discount. Never short deep discount / long
,
deep premium.

Confirmed reversal — in motion, NOT anticipated. Price has already shown the turn.
,
SMT with ES — bearish SMT for shorts, bullish for longs. The instrument that FAILS to make the high/low
,
is the weaker one = your trade. This is the single biggest confirmation filter.

Closed 5m trigger — 5m RB or CISD, closed, not forming. (See trigger rules below.)
,
Defined stop — above/below the structure, where the trade is wrong.
,
Trigger timeframe: 5m vs 1m
• Default = 5m RB / CISD. Higher win rate. Non-negotiable on countertrend trades. (Both Powell's teaching
and journal evidence: the 5m wins where the 1m fails.)
• 1m only if: the 5m stop is too large for your risk AND there's clean 1m structure inside it — e.g. a strong
1m RB on a swept data high/level, not random noise. The 1m is the exception, not the default.
• The trade-off: tighter (1m) stop = better RR but more likely to get edged out or BE'd; wider (5m) = lower RR
but higher win rate. On a high-RR system, protect the win rate.

Daily: PDH/PDL (taken vs untouched = draw), daily FVG/OB, ATH proximity, yesterday's close. If it's a
,

,

,
daily or conflict? Conflict = two-sided = lower conviction.

Sessions (15m): Asia/London high & low, what INITIATED the move (price expands away from what it
,
swept), untaken extremes = draws + likely manipulation levels, AMD structure.

“Bias: [direction / neutral]. We're [premium / discount]. Draw is [level]. Order flow is [bull / bear]. I
expect manipulation [where] then distribution toward [target]. Entry off [PD array] with SMT + closed 5m
trigger. Invalidation: [level].”

Today was a quite unfortunate trading day and I think I could have traded a lot smarter today. So it was a good day for lessons. I took two trades, one loss and one stop in profit.
,
I was bullish going into ny session because the overnight session was bearish, swept our daily relative equal lows, and showed a strong reaction to the upside. My first trade was a limit and we traded lower off of 10:00 and there was a 1h ifvg and a 15min bullish gap that lined up so I set my limit there. We consolidated before hitting the level and we had relative equal highs to the upside as well. It was a good trade, but we had an unmitigated 5min below that we tapped and stopped me out. (Screenshot 1)
,
The second trade I took was after we tapped the 5min fvg and swept another low and created a 3min rb that I entered off of. I got a very strong reaction of 95 points, but my own bread and butter is what stopped me. Price tapped 10:00 (we had a 5min rb that aligned with it) and gave a perfect top tick and stopped me out in profit. There’s a couple of things that I should have done for this trade: 1st is having my tp at 10:00 because I should have seen that it was a good setup to the downside, but I was just looking at the relative equal highs above. Second is trailing my stop aggressively to make 400 so that I could have gotten a day towards my payout. That would have been a super smart thing to do since I am onto the funded phase. Oh well, lesson learned and I will get it next time. (Screenshot 2)
,
That leaves me with the last thing, 10:00 played out beautifully, again. We traded up, tapped it and then gave a 300pt reaction. that 10:00 candle was a 5min rb so it was a valid entry too. (Screenshot 3)
,

I'm glad this is the trade I took because 1) I was in literally no drawdown, 2) looking at price now... my SL wouldve been triggered.

MMxM as initial framework 

15M + fair value gap for main area as rejection

Trail BE only after breaker is mitigated after –1-1 is always initial target

1 win = done and lockout

Hello everyone. Im Anton a 19yo trader from Finland. Ive been trading on and off for 5years, going from trading crypto with ema buy signal indicators, memecoins to support and resistance/pattern trading strategies on forex, ive lost well over 10k on my journey so far, ive got all the bad habbits, overtrading, revenge trading, fullporting for no reason, fomo entries etc. you name it ive prolly done it. 10months ago i got a reality check on my life 18yo living at my parents and broke, i decided ill give trading another chance after a 4month break, i loaded up yt and stubled upon tjrs bootcamp wich lit the light in me and gave me motivation to commit again. i went thru the bootcamp and since then i decided trading is going to be my only way to financial freedom, so i started to dig in deeper in trading, reading and studying all the books there is. after a while i got a 9-5 job and moved out to my own apartment with my gf while i kept trading as my second job, trading started well and i got funded multiple times but the pattern started again, overtrading, strategy hopping, lacking discipline etc. So ive never reached a payout. Midst of all this i stumbled upon @Powell  on tiktok, i watched him and the ppl he has mentored and got confident that this is the person that could give me some air under my wings, i took the risk and bought access to this discord and so far ive loved the community, and now i have made the decision to commit into this the way ive never been committed. My story off success will be here, for all of you to see. Youll see all the ups and downs but most importantly my progress. So get ready bc this gambler is going to make it no matter what.

God bless yall i hope success will reach us all.

primary_messages.author: Ferrone
primary_messages.content_text:
Day 40
7/8/26



Coming into today we're looking like we could go either way. I'm leaning bearish mostly because we are setting new lows on the HTF, we had a massive 450 pt selloff over night which we are currently rebalancing higher while creating LRL. My ideal play for today is we manipulate the first 15 mins into this 3 am OB + OTE then catch the reversal to LDN lows.

Off  open we do trade up into the OTE + OB and had a rejection but we are no pushing through again. We could come sweep london highs for a reversal but we are looking fairly strong at the moment. 

Sitting here patiently waiting, the market isn't giving me much to go off of. Kind of chopping but I do not want to force anything, waiting for my key levels to be hit and a clear trade for me. Probably the most patient I've been to not trade in a long time. We are damn choppy though SMH like what is this. 

We finally got the retrace from the open down into the 5m + 15m + OTE. I entered my longs targetting london highs. 2R trade. Scaled in after displacement + BoS. We get a clean delivery higher into 10 AM key open. Shortly after we get a trump candle straight to my SL. That shit pissed me right off ngl. Spent all morning being patient and having great discipline for that. Frustrating.

The loss is fine though. It happens. However I did get frustrated and let my emotions get the best of me. I proceed to take two more revenge trades. No real analysis just fading my old position. Scaling in and out, trading size that isn't the largest but with already being in drawdown, is probably too big. I fully acknowledge that I am acting on my emotions now. Definitely a frustrating day. It happens. Just got to call it here. And keep pushing the rest of the week.

primary_messages.content_text:
DAY 27  : 4 trades 2 BE 2 L's

Technical Analysis
Was looking for longs but same deal, was trying to long the bear run. luckily i caught a lot of BE's because i saw NQ break the low before ES. I cut my trades short early before ES ran through the low. Good tech. The others were caught in a consolidation. I found the breakers and even aligned them to the fvg for a silver bullet. I find that within these consolidations, the labs model has lower probability of working. Both trades also had SMT which should have signaled to me to BE early. usually in consolidation, it always hits the rejection block and then delivers. In fact the 5th trade which was paper was off the 5 min RB and it's playing out perfectly. Seems that being in the 7:30 time always fucks me. I usually never have a winning trade around that time.

Psychological Analysis
Notice that I get most nervous while in trades. Changing the cash to ticks helps a lot. Still get a bit tilted when i get edged or faded and it runs the way i want it to. Find myself getting myself into trades that i know aren't the best, but i want to gamble it. This must come from lack of patience. I'd like to say it's also because i wake up without full sleep and pay for it. But still i've mainly picked trades that stop me out 90% of the time. There's something that's happening that makes me take the L so often. I must be approaching something wrong.

primary_messages.content_text:
7/7/26
Day 39

Had a long night last night went to bed late and woke up late as well, got on about 5 minutes into open which is fine because I wait for the macro anyway.

Coming into today we look bearish on the higher time frame, trading lower. We have some bearish SMTs as well as bullish so it's hard to say if either side supports them. I probably won't be able to use it as a confluence since we have them on both sides. 

At open we get this judas swing higher taking out internal liquidity into a 5m CISD. Manipulating into a 15m bearish FVG. Followed by a sell off shorter into some sellside. We chop around for a bit higher until the macro. At this point we have filled a bearish 5m we made at open as well as tapping into the 5m RB of the judas swing + 1m OB. We finally get a clear BoS + displacement lower then a retrace into the 1m FVG while ES takes that high setting a strong bearish SMT. Targetting just enough to pass the account with 8 micros we hit a 2.08R today.

Another textbook setup in these choppy conditions.

server_rejection_phrase_messages.author: Tony
server_rejection_phrase_messages.content_text:
The Strategy in Plain English


Daily Bias Comes First
,

Never trade without knowing where price is likely headed.

The notes prioritize:


Daily candle direction (PxH/PxL)
,
Higher-timeframe liquidity
,
Previous highs/lows
,
Weekly context
,
Key opens
,

If the daily candle is bullish:


Expect the Daily High (PxH) to eventually be taken.
,

If bearish:


Expect the Daily Low (PxL) to eventually be taken.
,

⸻


AMD Model (Main Concept)
,

This is the backbone.

Accumulation


Market moves sideways.
,
Liquidity builds.
,

↓

Manipulation


Price sweeps liquidity.
,
Stops get triggered.
,

↓

Distribution


Real move begins.
,

Example:

Market ranges.

↓

Sweeps below the range.

↓

Immediately reclaims.

↓

Long toward higher liquidity.

Or

Market ranges.

↓

Sweeps above equal highs.

↓

Rejects.

↓

Short toward lower liquidity.

⸻


Trade With Liquidity
,

They’re constantly asking:

Where are traders trapped?

Look for:


Equal highs
,
Equal lows
,
Previous highs/lows
,
Session highs/lows
,
Engineered liquidity
,

The sweep is usually the entry signal—not the breakout.

⸻


CISD + Order Blocks
,

Wait for price to:


Sweep liquidity
,
Tap an Order Block or PDA
,
Show CISD (Change in State of Delivery)
,
Retest
,
Enter
,

The notes also mention:

Down-close candles often support higher prices.

Up-close candles often support lower prices.

Meaning don’t judge candles only by color—focus on where they formed.

⸻


Wick Theory
,

Entries are often taken from the wick.

Best timeframes:


4H
,
1H
,
15M
,
5M
,

A wick usually represents:

Liquidity sweep

↓

Rejection

↓

Real move begins

⸻


Top-Down Analysis
,

Every trade starts with:


Daily PxH/PxL
,
Key Opens
,
Equal highs/lows
,
MMXM
,
Higher-timeframe CISD
,
PD Arrays
,
Drop to lower timeframe for entry
,

No random entries.

⸻


Rejection Blocks
,

A rejection block is basically the candle that starts the rejection.

Use them when:


Price taps an FVG
,
Price taps an Order Block
,
Price taps liquidity
,

server_rejection_phrase_messages.content_text:
DAY 27  : 4 trades 2 BE 2 L's

Technical Analysis
Was looking for longs but same deal, was trying to long the bear run. luckily i caught a lot of BE's because i saw NQ break the low before ES. I cut my trades short early before ES ran through the low. Good tech. The others were caught in a consolidation. I found the breakers and even aligned them to the fvg for a silver bullet. I find that within these consolidations, the labs model has lower probability of working. Both trades also had SMT which should have signaled to me to BE early. usually in consolidation, it always hits the rejection block and then delivers. In fact the 5th trade which was paper was off the 5 min RB and it's playing out perfectly. Seems that being in the 7:30 time always fucks me. I usually never have a winning trade around that time.

Psychological Analysis
Notice that I get most nervous while in trades. Changing the cash to ticks helps a lot. Still get a bit tilted when i get edged or faded and it runs the way i want it to. Find myself getting myself into trades that i know aren't the best, but i want to gamble it. This must come from lack of patience. I'd like to say it's also because i wake up without full sleep and pay for it. But still i've mainly picked trades that stop me out 90% of the time. There's something that's happening that makes me take the L so often. I must be approaching something wrong.

broad_rb_shorthand_partial_messages.content_text:
july 17 Notes:


I was just watching charts this day and I saw some opportunities, but since I was working I wasn’t trading.
,
One thing that is interesting about today is I was thinking of the ict concept tgif (Thank god it’s friday) which happens when we see a large move down through monday through thursday we can see a retracement into the 20%-30% of the weekly range on friday. With that being said I was looking to have a bullish bias today. Price dropped over night hundreds of points during the overnight session and we saw a last judas at market open down into a bullish daily rb where we saw a big move up before and through 10:00 opening.
,
The first entry I would have like to see was a short after 10:00. We traded higher and swept equal highs and tapped a 4h bearish fvg and after tapping it we got some consolidation, but we made 1 move higher and made a 15min rb rejecting the 4h gap. Since it is a 15m wick, I would scaled down to the 1min and enter off of a 1min fvg inside the wick for better risk. Target is 10:00 and that would have been a successful trade. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
The next entry would have been a perfect bottom tick entry off of 10:00. 10:00 was in the discount of the range, and there was only 10pts of manipulation under 10:00 and usually I would like more, but we tapped into an hourly rb making it a valid 10:00 setup in my eyes. (Screenshot 3)
,

broad_rb_shorthand_partial_messages.content_text:
june 16 Notes:


This day was a vey unfortunate trading day as I ended with a loss, and a brutal, brutal breakeven.
,
9:30 opened and traded lower sweeping out daily lows and trading into a daily bullish rb and we rallied after this going into 10:00 putting it in a range. 10:00 opened and traded lower, tapping a 15min rb that rejected the sweep of el and tap of the rb, so I knew if we traded back into 10:00 it would be a great trade. My first trade was not this though, we traded lower into the range and tapped discount and a 5min fvg and created a 5min rb which is my model. The only problem here is that we didn’t tap 10:00. I entered anyways knowing that this could play out, or this is generating el for 10:00 which will be my re entry. it did get stopped, but then I entered 10: which did give a perfect entry. Now, I should have exited at the first swing high which was 110 points, a sufficient trade and a 1:5rr, but I was too ambitious and thought we would take out all the el above and I got stopped for this brutal breakeven. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
that first tp was definitely sufficient and those are the size trades I should be aiming for on this funded anyways and I could have broken this losing streak and I guess if I have to take away something positive it is that this adds more conviction to my edge and proves that I am very capable.
,

broad_rb_shorthand_partial_messages.author: Liam
broad_rb_shorthand_partial_messages.content_text:
july 15 Notes:


Lost 2 trades unfortunately this day. This journal comes a little late, but here it is. Next week I will do a good job of completing every journal I have in a timely manner.
,
Going into market open, it looked like we had a clear draw which was relative equal highs and a high tf market maker buy model. We had swept those daily equal lows, reacted out, traded back down into ote and back up making this mmxm. This meant I was bullish for the day. Market traded down aggressively at market open into the ote of this new range and I saw a stack of relative equal lows and accumulation that got swept near the 0.705 and once we swept it, we got a bullish 5min rb. The problem is that the wick was too big and I entered off of it with a meaningless stop loss and got stopped. We then accumulated in this area and we got a resweep of the low and a new bullish 5min rb and I entered again, but had the same problem: meaningless stop just in the middle of the wick somewhere and got stopped. Now, neither of these trades would have properly hit my tp, but they would have been enough to get be or a trailed win. (Screenshots 1-3)
,
I mentioned that neither of these trades hit my tp, and one thing that I think could have been an issue is that it doesn’t really make sense for us to sweep level, rally, trade into ote, make mmxm make relative equal highs with the top of it, and then trade back to ote again and expect another rally. How I should have interpreted it was htf liquidity generation, and just sat on my hand not knowing a proper direction. Another thing is That I should adjust my entry in order to cover the wick with sl, not adjust my sl to get into the trade. lessons learned.
,
